errors.description: L-1 in Plumbing Fixture Schedule on page 1 lists a flow rate of 5.0 gpm (5 gpm), which is off by a unit conversion; the value should read 0.5 gpm aerators maximum (0.5 gpm). See 22 40 00. (spec.pdf p1 requires 0.5 gpm aerators maximum for Lavatory faucets)
D-202 in Door Schedule on page 1 lists a fire rating of 45 min, which conflicts with 90-minute (90 min) in spec.pdf page 1. See 08 11 00. (spec.pdf p1 requires 90-minute for mechanical rooms)
